proof_body:
by
  intro V P _ _ _ _ A B C D E hD hE hr
  have hAB : dist A B ≠ 0 := dist_ne_zero.mpr hD.left_ne_right
  have hAC : dist A C ≠ 0 := dist_ne_zero.mpr hE.left_ne_right
  have hDA : D ≠ A := hD.ne_left
  obtain ⟨⟨s, hs, rfl⟩, -, -⟩ := hD
  obtain ⟨⟨t, ht, rfl⟩, -, -⟩ := hE
  rw [dist_left_lineMap, dist_left_lineMap, mul_div_assoc, mul_div_assoc, div_self hAB, div_self hAC,
    mul_one, mul_one, Real.norm_of_nonneg hs.1, Real.norm_of_nonneg ht.1] at hr
  subst hr
  have hs0 : s ≠ 0 := by
    rintro rfl; simp at hDA
  rw [AffineSubspace.affineSpan_pair_parallel_iff_vectorSpan_eq, vectorSpan_pair_rev, vectorSpan_pair_rev]
  have h : AffineMap.lineMap A C s -ᵥ AffineMap.lineMap A B s = s • (C -ᵥ B) := by
    simp only [AffineMap.lineMap_apply, vadd_vsub_vadd_cancel_right]
    rw [← vsub_sub_vsub_cancel_right C B A, smul_sub]
  rw [h]
  exact Submodule.span_singleton_smul_eq (IsUnit.mk0 _ hs0) _
